why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to ' 30A Dunes ' professionally managed by Stay on 30a. A 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in the gated community of WaterSound that comfortably sleeps 8. This inviting retreat blends timeless coastal charm with elevated design and craftsmanship, creating a warm and elegant escape just steps from the Gulf! Inside, the home’s thoughtful design shines through in every detail, from the Venetian plaster walls to the 100-year-old repurposed wooden beams that add both texture and character. The open-concept living and dining spaces offer the perfect backdrop for gathering with family and friends, while the well-equipped kitchen makes preparing meals and entertaining a pleasure. Step outside to your own private oasis featuring a sparkling pool and a spacious screened-in porch complete with a fireplace and TV, perfect for slow mornings with coffee or cozy evenings under the glow of the fire. When you’re ready for sand and surf, the private deeded beach access is just steps away, offering effortless days along the sugar-white shoreline. Guests also enjoy access to two community pools and six adult bikes, ideal for exploring the scenic paths, trails, and neighboring coastal towns along 30A. With its refined interiors, inviting outdoor spaces, and unbeatable location, 30A Dunes offers the perfect balance of comfort, craftsmanship, and coastal relaxation.
